prompt:
You read the transcript of a podcast/interview in which the AI-safety researcher Marius Hobbhahn (CEO of Apollo Research) is the guest and Nathan Labenz is the host. Extract items from what MARIUS says, never from the host's questions, introductions or summaries.

Return 3-15 items. Each item is one of:
- "decision": a research decision he (or his team) made, where another choice was possible;
- "rejected": an option, method or line of work he rejected or argued against;
- "disagreement": a place where he disagrees with a default view or practice in the field;
- "advice": advice he gives about how to do research (what to work on, how to test, how to interpret results).
Prefer research methodology (evaluation design, experimental controls, what evidence to trust, which questions to pursue, how strongly to state claims) over biography, logistics or summaries of results. Only include items the text itself supports; return {"decisions": []} if there are none. For each item give:
- item_type: decision / rejected / disagreement / advice
- point: one of D1-D6 (D1 which experiment or hypothesis to pursue; D2 what evidence to collect; D3 whether to accept a result; D4 whether to continue or drop a line of work; D5 how to interpret an ambiguous result; D6 how strongly to state a claim)
- problem: the research problem or question faced, stated neutrally (1 sentence)
- did: what he chose, did or recommends (1 sentence)
- alternatives_named: a JSON list of strings, the alternatives the text itself names or rejects ([] if none)
- stated_reason: the reason the text gives ("" if none)
- quote: a VERBATIM passage of HIS OWN words, 15-60 words, copied character for character, that shows the item. Do not paraphrase, fix spelling or punctuation, merge passages, or use ellipses.
- off_topic: true if the item is not about AI, ML or research practice (e.g. energy policy, health, productivity), else false

Return only JSON: {"decisions": [{"item_type": ..., "point": ..., "problem": ..., "did": ..., "alternatives_named": [...], "stated_reason": ..., "quote": ..., "off_topic": ...}]}
